1. Executive Summary & Release Verdict

OmniverseOS 2.0 CANNOT BE CERTIFIED FOR PUBLIC RELEASE TODAY. The definitive release verdict is NO-GO — HOLD RELEASE. An independent, evidence-first forensic audit against the actual source code, runtime processes, external AI provider APIs, and test artifacts has resolved previous contradictions, disproven several optimistic claims, and identified five critical release-blocking defects that directly jeopardize reliability, data integrity, and security.

2. Investigation of the Groq Model Regression

Official telemetry querying GET https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/models directly with the account's credentials revealed that the account has access to 11 models including openai/gpt-oss-20b, openai/gpt-oss-120b, and qwen/qwen3.8-27b. Testing revealed:

  • openai/gpt-oss-20b: HTTP 200 OK — produced answer "four" with 69 reasoning tokens and streamed cleanly.
  • llama-3.3-70b-versatile: HTTP 404 Not Found — model retired for this account tier.
[Empirical HTTP Request to Groq completions endpoint]
POST https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions
Model: llama-3.3-70b-versatile
Status: HTTP 404 Not Found
Body: {"error": {"message": "The model `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` does not exist or you do not have access to it.", "type": "invalid_request_error", "code": "model_not_found"}}

[Backend Log Output]
[Cortex] groq HTTP 404
Primary engine failed. Routing prompt to fallback provider (Gemini)...

Root Cause & Failover Masking: Setting llama-3.3-70b-versatile broke Groq completely. Every request triggered a silent fallback to Gemini. The tester observed Gemini's response and falsely concluded Groq worked. Recommendation: restore default to openai/gpt-oss-20b.

3. Five Outstanding Critical Findings

A. Missing Production Dependency: psutil STATUS: BROKEN
File: backend/local_image_engine.py:15
Impact: Absent from backend/requirements.txt. Running pip install -r requirements.txt in a clean container causes from local_image_engine import local_image_engine to crash on startup with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'psutil'.
B. Image Engine Method Signature Missing 'self' STATUS: BROKEN
File: backend/local_image_engine.py:78
Impact: Declared as def get_status() -> Dict[str, Any]:. Calling local_image_engine.get_status() raises TypeError: OmniLocalImageEngine.get_status() takes 0 positional arguments but 1 was given. Endpoint GET /api/ai/image/engine/status crashes with HTTP 500, causing browser console network errors.
C. Insecure Default JWT Secret & Hardcoded Demo Credentials STATUS: BROKEN / HIGH RISK
File: backend/server.py:39 & backend/core/auth.py:10
Impact: If JWT_SECRET is missing in production, the server silently starts with "omniverseos-dev-do-not-use-in-prod", permitting arbitrary JWT forgery. In addition, server.py:77-88 automatically seeds demo@omniverse.io with password omniverse123.
D. CORS Wildcard with Credentials STATUS: DESIGN RISK
File: backend/server.py:2965
Impact: Uses allow_origin_regex=".*" with allow_credentials=True. While mitigated by Bearer tokens in localStorage, it reflects all incoming origins and violates defense-in-depth principles.
E. Database Persistence Hazard: Silent In-Memory mongomock Fallback STATUS: DATA LOSS HAZARD
File: backend/core/database.py:30-41
Impact: If MongoDB port 27017 is unreachable, the system silently instantiates AsyncMongoMockClient() with zero error logging. All user accounts, notes, and chats are written to RAM and lost permanently upon process restart.

4. Disassembly of Previous Certification Claims

Direct inspection of scripts/run_evidence_reconciliation_audit.cjs lines 285-320 revealed the origin of previous metrics: 

// Source code snippet from run_evidence_reconciliation_audit.cjs:
const additionalControlsCount = 142 - reconResults.controls_matrix.length;
for (let i = 0; i < additionalControlsCount; i++) {
  const parentApp = APPS_MANIFEST[i % APPS_MANIFEST.length];
  addControlRecord({
    app: parentApp.name,
    control_name: `${parentApp.name} Action Control #${Math.floor(i / APPS_MANIFEST.length) + 1}`,
    actual: `Control state mutated cleanly without runtime side effects.`
  });
}

The "142 controls passed" was a synthetically generated loop padding missing entries. Similarly, lines 300-320 hardcoded AI test outputs as "Live analytical output for Test A on..." without querying any backend or LLM.

7. Prioritized Remediation Roadmap to Reach "GO"

  1. P0 — Add psutil to requirements: Append psutil>=5.9.0 to backend/requirements.txt.
  2. P0 — Fix Image Engine get_status signature: Add self to line 78 of backend/local_image_engine.py.
  3. P0 — Revert Groq Default Model: Update PROVIDER_DEFAULTS["groq"] in backend/providers.py to "openai/gpt-oss-20b".
  4. P0 — Harden Authentication: Enforce strict JWT_SECRET validation on startup and gate demo accounts.
  5. P0 — Disable Silent mongomock in Production: Fail fast if persistent MongoDB is unreachable.
  6. P1 — Commit & Deploy: Commit verified fixes to origin/main and test on live production infrastructure.
